builder.name: Ravi: first conversation (lead from Instagram ad about passive income)

situation.scenario: The learner speaks with Ravi, who came in as a lead from: Instagram ad about passive income. Banking job in Oman. Saved for 3 years to invest in Dubai for passive income. Owns one home in Oman. Married, two kids. Decision includes wife. Budget 1.5–2.0M AED (via mortgage; can start lower); timeline 3–6 months.
situation.hiddenTruth:
Held back until the learner earns it:
• Motivation: medium
• What matters most: Best price 40%; Market conditions 30%; Time constraints 30%
• Constraints: risk-averse; prefers simple mortgage process; new to Dubai market
• Areas: open to guidance; maybe JVC / Dubai Hills (if asked)
situation.agreesWhen: The learner offers: questions about purpose and family needs; clarity on affordability and mortgage steps.
situation.declinesWhen: The learner uses: guaranteed returns; pressuring timelines.
